prompt: Create one polished art-direction contact sheet for Codememes, an independent meme-association tabletop game. This is a TOKEN ART REFERENCE, not a website or UI mockup. Exactly four separate horizontal playing-card cover illustrations arranged in a balanced 2-by-2 grid, all the same 3:2 proportion, fully visible with generous cream gutters on a warm off-white background. Flat front-on view of printed cards, very slight soft edge shadows, subtle cream cardstock grain, thin inset printed border, restrained rounded corners. No lettering, numbers, captions, logos, watermarks, or brand mark anywhere. The cards should feel like beautifully printed physical board-game identity covers with funny expressive original characters, not glossy trading cards, photorealism or generic vector icons. Use bold screen-printed editorial illustration, confident ink outlines, textured flat colors and large silhouettes recognizable at thumbnail size. Top left RED AGENT: brick-red #b83e3b face with cream details, an original smug Shiba-like dog in a little suit and sunglasses posing with excessive meme-like confidence, knowing stonks energy, original composition. Top right BLUE AGENT: denim-blue #296aa1 face with cream details, an original wide-eyed calculating cat in a little agent jacket, one paw at its temple and a small diagrammatic brain glow drawn as ink rays, galaxy-brain reaction energy. Bottom left NEUTRAL BYSTANDER: tan #c8ad7f face with cream details, an original deadpan capybara wearing a casual tiny bucket hat and holding a warm mug, unbothered internet reaction energy, no suit. Bottom right ASSASSIN: near-black charcoal #252323 face with cream details, a mischievous dramatic skeleton in a hoodie looking at a phone, skull-reaction doomscroll energy, unmistakable skull silhouette, playful and non-gory. Each cover has its own distinct character silhouette and a simple small category emblem: red angular pennant, blue round target, neutral hollow diamond, assassin skull shape. The meme mood is carried by expressive illustration, never baked-in text. Strong family resemblance across all four covers. The physical game's geometry and tactile printing are inspiration only; invent original art, frames and characters. Keep the work lively, warm, legible and dignified as a real tabletop product.
notes: Historical four-cover concept contact sheet. The portrait composition, dominant category color and Wojak Assassin brief now supersede its detailed scenes, decorative frames, animal cast and skeleton Assassin. Not individual production assets, a shipping sprite sheet or an approved UI layout.
